outcome: A detach function releases only the attachment it was returned for. After the page has torn the client down with `destroy()` and mounted again on the same client with a fresh `dataLayer()`, running the stale detach from the first mount changes nothing the page can see: `layer.push` keeps the identity it had, the live attachment still captures the next push to the transport exactly once, and the page's array still holds one entry per push.
